name: Lynyrd Skynyrd

whyMatters.en: Jacksonville Southern hard-rock band with a three-guitar lineup. Free Bird and Sweet Home Alabama put dual/triple-lead writing and open-G country riffs on 1970s FM. The 1977 plane crash ended the Van Zant peak; Johnny Van Zant later fronted reunions.
whyMatters.zh: 杰克逊维尔南方硬摇滚乐队，三吉他编制。《Free Bird》与《Sweet Home Alabama》把双/三主音写法与 open-G country riff 送上 1970 年代 FM。1977 年空难结束 Van Zant 高峰；其后由 Johnny Van Zant 主唱重聚。

lyricQuotes: If I leave here tomorrow / Would you still remember me
Sweet home Alabama / Where the skies are so blue

shortBio.en: Jacksonville three-guitar Southern hard rock; Free Bird / Sweet Home Alabama FM staples; 1977 crash; Johnny Van Zant reunions.
shortBio.zh: 杰克逊维尔三吉他南方硬摇滚；《Free Bird》/《Sweet Home Alabama》FM 常备；1977 空难；Johnny Van Zant 重聚。

body.en:
Childhood friends Ronnie Van Zant, Gary Rossington, and Allen Collins formed Noble Five in Jacksonville in 1964, then My Backyard with Bob Burns and Larry Junstrom. By 1970 the name Leonard Skinnerd mocked gym teacher Leonard Skinner at Robert E. Lee High School, settling as Lynyrd Skynyrd. Early Southern tours featured heavy, guitar-drunk boogie—British rock (Cream, Rolling Stones, Yardbirds) filtered through raw blues and country, distinct from Allman Brothers’ jazz-leaning Fillmore jams.

After Muscle Shoals demos, Al Kooper (Blood, Sweat & Tears) produced the first three albums after catching them for a week in Atlanta—he told Rolling Stone he heard a different strong original each night. (Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd) (1973) reached US No.27 with Tuesday’s Gone, Simple Man, Gimme Three Steps, and Free Bird—the three-guitar climax fans still shout for live. Free Bird hit the Top 20 only in 1975, after Second Helping (1974) and Sweet Home Alabama’s Top 10 breakthrough made them stars.

Nuthin’ Fancy (1975) entered the Top 10; Gimme Back My Bullets (1977) peaked at No.5. Three days after Street Survivors’ release, on 20 October 1977, the tour plane nicknamed Free Bird crashed in Mississippi—Van Zant, Steve Gaines, and backing singer Cassie Gaines died. Gold & Platinum (1979) went triple platinum as a five-album summary. Survivors reunited for the crash’s tenth anniversary; Johnny Van Zant later fronted the name. Rickey Medlocke (ex–Blackfoot), who briefly sang and drummed in 1970, returned on guitar. Post-1987 studio albums continued; God & Guns (2009) was the first Top 20 studio set since Street Survivors.
body.zh:
儿时玩伴 Ronnie Van Zant、Gary Rossington、Allen Collins 于 1964 年在杰克逊维尔组建 Noble Five，后与 Bob Burns、Larry Junstrom 改称 My Backyard。1970 年前后团名 Leonard Skinnerd 挖苦罗伯特·E·李高中体育老师 Leonard Skinner，最终定为 Lynyrd Skynyrd。早期南方巡演是沉重、吉他浓密的布吉——英国摇滚（Cream、Rolling Stones、Yardbirds）经原始蓝调与乡村过滤，有别于 Allman Brothers 偏爵士、迎合 Fillmore 扎染听众的即兴。

Muscle Shoals 小样之后，Al Kooper（Blood, Sweat & Tears）在亚特兰大听他们驻唱一周，为前三张专辑制作——他对《滚石》说每晚都能听到不同的出色原创。《(Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd)》（1973）美榜第 27，含《Tuesday's Gone》《Simple Man》《Gimme Three Steps》《Free Bird》——三吉他高潮至今仍有人在现场大喊点播。《Free Bird》直到 1975 年才进前 20，此时《Second Helping》（1974）与《Sweet Home Alabama》前 10 已把他们推成明星。

《Nuthin' Fancy》（1975）进专辑榜前 10；《Gimme Back My Bullets》（1977）最高第 5。《Street Survivors》发行三天后，1977 年 10 月 20 日绰号 Free Bird 的巡演飞机在密西西比坠毁——Van Zant、Steve Gaines 与和音 Cassie Gaines 罹难。《Gold & Platinum》（1979）三白金，总结五张录音室专辑。幸存者在空难十周年重聚；后由 Johnny Van Zant 任主唱。前 Blackfoot 的 Rickey Medlocke（1970 年曾短暂司鼓/主唱）回归吉他。1987 年后继续发行录音室专辑；《God & Guns》（2009）是自《Street Survivors》后首次进前 20 的录音室专辑。

note.en: Ballad into three-guitar climax; piano intro then stacked solos. Live crowds still shout for it.
note.zh: 谣曲推到三吉他高潮；钢琴 intro 后叠 solo。现场观众至今仍大喊点播。

note.en: Open-G riff and three-guitar weave; Second Helping Top 10 single.
note.zh: Open-G riff 与三吉他编织；《Second Helping》前 10 单曲。

note.en: Warning track from Street Survivors; Gaines-era three-guitar density. Issued days before the crash.
note.zh: 出自《Street Survivors》的警告曲；Gaines 期三吉他密度。发行数日后空难。

body.en:
Skynyrd stacks interlocking rhythm and dual/triple lead—British hard-rock volume through Southern blues and country.

Free Bird and Sweet Home Alabama are the two poles: extended solo architecture versus a three-chord regional anthem.

Van Zant’s plainspoken verses and Powell’s piano mark the classic records.
body.zh:
Skynyrd 叠交织节奏与双/三主音——英国 hard-rock 音量经南方蓝调与乡村过滤。

《Free Bird》与《Sweet Home Alabama》是两极：延长 solo 结构，以及三和弦地域颂歌。

Van Zant 直白话主歌与 Powell 钢琴是经典唱片的识别点。

title.en: Kooper years: debut to Street Survivors
title.zh: Kooper 时期：首专到 Street Survivors

body.en:
Al Kooper produced the first three LPs after Atlanta club nights. The debut taught crowds to spell the name; Second Helping and Sweet Home Alabama made them FM stars.

Ed King completed the three-guitar Second Helping era; Steve Gaines joined for Street Survivors. Artimus Pyle replaced Bob Burns mid-decade.

Book contrast: Allmans’ jazz Fillmore jams versus Skynyrd’s Southern hinterland boogie.
body.zh:
Al Kooper 在亚特兰大俱乐部驻唱后制作前三张专辑。首专教会观众拼写团名；《Second Helping》与《Sweet Home Alabama》把他们送上 FM 明星位。

Ed King 补齐《Second Helping》三吉他；Steve Gaines 加入《Street Survivors》。十年中期 Artimus Pyle 替换 Bob Burns。

书中对照：Allmans 的爵士 Fillmore 即兴，对 Skynyrd 的南方腹地布吉。

title.en: 1977 crash and Johnny Van Zant years
title.zh: 1977 空难与 Johnny Van Zant 时期

body.en:
On 20 October 1977 the Free Bird tour plane crashed in Mississippi. Ronnie Van Zant, Steve Gaines, and Cassie Gaines died; the original peak ended.

Gold & Platinum (1979) summarized five studio albums. Tenth-anniversary reunions led to Johnny Van Zant on vocals. Rickey Medlocke (ex–Blackfoot; 1970 brief member) returned on guitar.

God & Guns (2009) was the first Top 20 studio album since Street Survivors.
body.zh:
1977 年 10 月 20 日 Free Bird 巡演飞机在密西西比坠毁。Ronnie Van Zant、Steve Gaines、Cassie Gaines 罹难；原班高峰结束。

《Gold & Platinum》（1979）总结五张录音室专辑。十周年重聚后由 Johnny Van Zant 主唱。Rickey Medlocke（前 Blackfoot；1970 年短暂成员）回归吉他。

《God & Guns》（2009）是自《Street Survivors》后首次进前 20 的录音室专辑。

alt.en: Allen Collins, Ronnie Van Zant, and Gary Rossington
alt.zh: Allen Collins、Ronnie Van Zant 与 Gary Rossington

body.en:
Piano/organ ballad into stacked guitar solos—the concert climax form.

Chart Top 20 only in 1975, after Sweet Home Alabama had already made the band famous.
body.zh:
钢琴/风琴谣曲推到叠吉他 solo——演唱会高潮结构。

直到 1975 年才进榜前 20，其时《Sweet Home Alabama》已让乐队成名。

title.en: Southern hard rock on US FM
title.zh: 美国 FM 上的南方硬摇滚

body.en:
Guns N’ Roses and later Southern/hard-rock acts cite the three-guitar weave and Free Bird climax structure.

Sweet Home Alabama remains a widely taught open-G riff. Scene place is US FM hard rock crossed with country-rock.
body.zh:
Guns N’ Roses 与后来的南方/硬摇滚乐队引用三吉他编织与《Free Bird》高潮结构。

《Sweet Home Alabama》仍是常练的 open-G riff。场景位置在美国 FM 硬摇滚与 country-rock 交叉。
